title: Left exact functors commute with good upper truncation
statement: Let F:C->D be an additive functor between abelian categories and K a cochain complex. The mapped truncated complex F(tau<=q K) is zero above q, so its own truncation inclusion is invertible. Its inverse followed by truncation of F of the inclusion defines a canonical comparison to tau<=q(FK), compatible with the full inclusions. If F preserves finite limits, this comparison is an isomorphism.

source.document: Stacks Project, Derived Categories and Homology

proof.text: Define the comparison by inverting the truncation inclusion of the mapped already-truncated complex, then applying truncation to the mapped inclusion. Naturality proves compatibility with the full inclusions.

At the boundary q identify the truncation inclusion with the cycles inclusion composed with truncLEXIsoCycles. Compute the dual truncGE projection using liftExtend_f and restrictionToTruncGE′_f_eq_iso_hom_pOpcycles_iso_inv; the opcyclesOpIso compatibility gives the claimed identity after unop. The cycles inclusion kills the differential, and HomologicalComplex.cyclesIsKernel followed by IsKernel.isoKernel transports its kernel universal property to the truncation inclusion. This is a direct coordinate calculation from the Mathlib truncation definitions; it does not use the successive-truncation short exact sequence.

Evaluate the comparison in degree p. For p < q both truncation inclusions are isomorphisms by CochainComplex.isIso_ιTruncLE_f, and compatibility lets one cancel the target inclusion. For p = q, preservation of kernels gives two limiting kernel forks and therefore a unique isomorphism; compatibility and monicity identify it with the comparison component. For p > q both objects are zero. The componentwise isomorphism criterion completes the proof.

def mapTruncLEComparison (F : C ⥤ D) [F.Additive]
    (K : CochainComplex C ℤ) (q : ℤ) :
    (F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (K.truncLE q) ⟶
      CochainComplex.truncLE ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K) q
